summary: The prepared main source already contains the test correction from upstream commit 2969ab3d4: the SchedulerProfilerManager MPS tests mock torch.mps.profiler.metal_capture rather than the unrelated mx.metal capture API, assert context lifecycle, and pin use_mlx=False. No product-code change was justified.

tests.what_was_measured: The actual checked-in regression file collected successfully; all 10 tests were skipped by its Apple-Silicon-and-MLX guard on this Linux host. This is not a passing Metal execution claim.

Against the actual current profiler module, a mocked MPS capture context was entered and exited exactly once, and an independent RuntimeError boundary returned success=false with the injected error and capture-enablement guidance.

gpu_execution_evidence: The host exposes one AMD Instinct MI355X through ROCm, but the reported path requires Apple Silicon Metal/MPS and mlx is not installed. No irrelevant ROCm execution is presented as Metal validation.
remaining_limitations: No Apple Silicon or Metal runtime was available, so the full hardware-specific pytest run could not be independently repeated.
The platform-neutral harness validates only the mocked MPS capture lifecycle and failure conversion, not creation of a real .gputrace.
Apple-Silicon passing evidence in the upstream issue discussion was retained as external evidence but was not reproduced on this host.
